purpose: Create reproducible labels for the finalized PTC bale inspection workflow without inventing unobservable states.

objectClasses.name: bale_closed
objectClasses.definition: A bale that has entered the inspection area and is not yet visibly opened.

objectClasses.name: bale_opened
objectClasses.definition: A bale with visibly opened/cut wrapping or exposed material.

objectClasses.name: inspector
objectClasses.definition: A person participating in the inspection process. Do not identify the person.

objectClasses.name: grade_indicator
objectClasses.definition: Only a visible grade signal, label, gesture, screen or artifact that humans can label consistently.

objectClasses.name: scale_display
objectClasses.definition: The complete visible weighing-machine display used for OCR.

temporalLabels.name: opening_completed
temporalLabels.definition: The bale changes from closed to visibly opened.
temporalLabels.minimumEvidence: Clear before/after visual evidence within one camera-local bale track.

temporalLabels.name: hand_inspection_proper
temporalLabels.definition: Sustained hand interaction with the opened bale, with meaningful movement and sufficient visibility.
temporalLabels.minimumEvidence: Contact duration and movement are visible for the approved process duration.

temporalLabels.name: hand_inspection_incomplete
temporalLabels.definition: Some hand interaction is visible but it does not meet the approved duration, movement or coverage rule.
temporalLabels.minimumEvidence: A brief/partial interaction is visible and distinguishable from full inspection.

temporalLabels.name: hand_inspection_none
temporalLabels.definition: The bale leaves the applicable stage with no observable hand inspection.
temporalLabels.minimumEvidence: Sufficient visibility exists to rule out inspection.

temporalLabels.name: grading_completed
temporalLabels.definition: The approved visible grading signal is observed.
temporalLabels.minimumEvidence: A visible, PM-approved grading signal; do not infer hidden/manual decisions.

temporalLabels.name: routing_accepted
temporalLabels.definition: The tracked bale enters the approved accepted-lane ROI.
temporalLabels.minimumEvidence: Bale center/track crosses the accepted ROI with sufficient continuity.

temporalLabels.name: routing_rejected
temporalLabels.definition: The tracked bale enters the approved left-side rejected-lane ROI.
temporalLabels.minimumEvidence: Bale center/track crosses the rejected ROI with sufficient continuity.

temporalLabels.name: weight_stable
temporalLabels.definition: The scale display shows a stable numeric value across the approved consecutive-frame window.
temporalLabels.minimumEvidence: Human-readable display crop and ground-truth numeric value.

temporalLabels.name: weight_unreadable
temporalLabels.definition: The display is present but no reliable numeric value can be read.
temporalLabels.minimumEvidence: Display ROI is visible; glare, blur, obstruction or resolution prevents reading.

temporalLabels.name: insufficient_visibility
temporalLabels.definition: The process state cannot be determined because the relevant area is obstructed, out of frame or technically unusable.
temporalLabels.minimumEvidence: The annotator records the cause rather than assigning a process violation.

splitRules.unit: complete source video, camera session or collection block
